title: Editorial lifecycle
description: The state machine, expressed so both sides implement ONE definition. canTransition is the ONLY way to move; there is no direct state assignment.

transitions.description: from → the states it may legally reach. A transition not listed here does not exist.

terminal.description: nextStates(deprecated) returns []. A deprecated version is immutable.

consumerVisible.description: Consumers read APPROVED only. Drafts, returned drafts and deprecated versions are invisible to them.

immutableStates.description: An approved version is never edited — only superseded. A deprecated one is frozen.
